description: Current GO set for P21683 plus the family-wide cellular component annotation survey
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- A. Current GO annotation set for P21683 (QuickGO REST, goName can be null -> use goId + fill names) ----
r=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
               params={"geneProductId":"UniProtKB:P21683","limit":100},
               headers={"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=60).json()
rows=[]
for a in r["results"]:
    rows.append((a["goAspect"],a["goId"],a["goEvidence"],a["evidenceCode"],a["reference"],a.get("assignedBy")))
names={}
for g in sorted({x[1] for x in rows}):
    t=requests.get(f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/ontology/go/terms/{g}",
                   headers={"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=30).json()
    names[g]=t["results"][0]["name"]
print("P21683 current GO annotations (QuickGO, n=%d)"%len(rows))
for asp,g,ev,ec,ref,by in sorted(rows):
    print(f"  {asp:20s} {g} {names[g][:44]:46s} {ev:4s} {ref:22s} {by}")
cc=[x for x in rows if x[0]=="cellular_component"]
print("\n  cellular_component annotations on P21683: %d"%len(cc))

# ---- B. Family-wide CC annotation survey (values computed in the two previous UniProt survey calls) ----
survey={
 "Bacteria\nCrtB (all)":      dict(n=500, annotated=0),
 "Bacteria\nCrtB (reviewed)": dict(n=14,  annotated=0),
 "Viridiplantae\nPSY/SQS":    dict(n=32,  annotated=30),
 "Fungi\nCrtYB/ERG9":         dict(n=34,  annotated=33),
 "Metazoa\nSQS":              dict(n=10,  annotated=10),
}
labs=list(survey); frac=[100*survey[k]["annotated"]/survey[k]["n"] for k in labs]
ns=[survey[k]["n"] for k in labs]

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
cols=["#b02418","#b02418","#2a6f3f","#2a6f3f","#2a6f3f"]
b=ax[0].bar(range(5),frac,color=cols,edgecolor="black",linewidth=.6)
for i,(f,n) in enumerate(zip(frac,ns)):
    ax[0].text(i,f+2.5,f"{survey[labs[i]]['annotated']}/{n}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(5)); ax[0].set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8.5)
ax[0].set_ylabel("entries with a subcellular location comment (%)")
ax[0].set_ylim(0,112)
ax[0].set_title("UniProt subcellular location across the PF00494 family",fontsize=10)
ax[0].axhline(0,color="black",lw=.8)

# CC terms used, by kingdom (counts from the UniProt go_c field survey)
terms={
 "ER membrane (GO:0005789)":        dict(plant=18,fungi=15,metazoa=5,bact=0),
 "membrane (GO:0016020)":           dict(plant=0, fungi=20,metazoa=0,bact=0),
 "plastoglobule (GO:0010287)":      dict(plant=10,fungi=0, metazoa=0,bact=0),
 "chloroplast memb (GO:0031969)":   dict(plant=4, fungi=0, metazoa=0,bact=0),
 "chromoplast (GO:0009509)":        dict(plant=4, fungi=0, metazoa=0,bact=0),
 "plastid stroma (GO:0009532)":     dict(plant=3, fungi=0, metazoa=0,bact=0),
 "mito inner memb (GO:0005743)":    dict(plant=0, fungi=0, metazoa=5,bact=0),
 "cytoplasm (GO:0005737)":          dict(plant=0, fungi=0, metazoa=4,bact=0),
}
tl=list(terms); y=np.arange(len(tl)); w=.21
for k,(grp,c) in enumerate(zip(["plant","fungi","metazoa","bact"],
                               ["#2a6f3f","#7b4ea0","#1f6fb4","#b02418"])):
    ax[1].barh(y+(1.5-k)*w,[terms[t][grp] for t in tl],height=w,color=c,label=grp,edgecolor="black",linewidth=.4)
ax[1].set_yticks(y); ax[1].set_yticklabels(tl,fontsize=8.5); ax[1].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].set_xlabel("number of reviewed entries carrying the GO CC term")
ax[1].set_title("GO cellular component terms used in the family\n(bacterial CrtB: zero terms of any kind)",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({"p21683_go":[list(x) for x in rows],"names":names,"survey":survey,"terms":terms},
          open("struct/_go_survey.json","w"),indent=1)
print("\nsaved struct/_go_survey.json")
